Prior coverage file COVERAGE_EXTENSION_V7.jsonl and live queue status were checked; with zero running leases and zero ledger-active leases, RPL-COVERAGE-0024 priority was lowered 5->-1 under Lock(), the supervisor-signed claim ran with control verified, and priority was restored to 5 under a second Lock().
